protocol.kv: official NUQ4; 0.99 percentile outlier rule; no first-token exclusion; no rotation
protocol.key_location: after k_norm, before RoPE; static per-channel
protocol.value_location: active C1 latent coordinates; dynamic per-token over all KV heads
protocol.fisher: BF16 C1 arm-specific squared activation gradients; frozen across quantized arms
protocol.projections: folded V encoder and output decoder only; padded HF V/O slots
protocol.fp8: actual E4M3 W8A8 scaled GEMM; BF16 output; use_fast_accum=False
protocol.fp8_scales: tensorwise weights; static per-projection training absmax activation scales; matching KV setting
protocol.other_modules: BF16; full attention; no sparse routing; no MLP quantization
